claim: SAC seed 1 has no intermediate checkpoints. Only its FINAL state (691080 env steps) survives.
cause: Per-step checkpoint retention was committed while SAC seed 1 was already running. The live process held the pre-commit code, which wrote only <ALGO>_ckpt_latest.pt and overwrote it at every eval sweep. sac_s2 and rlpd, launched after the commit, have the full 7-checkpoint set.
consequence: The ~414k SAC seed 1 checkpoint -- where that seed's carry rate peaked at 0.36 (n=25) -- CANNOT be re-evaluated, re-rendered, or verified. Any claim about SAC s1 @414k rests solely on the n=25 training-time evaluation recorded in runs/sac.json plus one training-time video of eval condition 0.
